label: PREDICTED: whole-field oblique clean windows from src/robustness.py's section model with literature aero (research/params_lit.json, ASSUMED, not POLLEN measurements). Window = clean air-only entry, not a hit probability; no repeatability claim.

provenance.psi_gt_60: ASSUMED extrapolation: robustness.py treats psi > 60 as infeasible

frame.x: field x = shot axis: distance from the HIVE pivot plane (x = 0); d = |x|
frame.y: along the pivot axis; up-cell aim point at y = 0 (red HIVE centre); the other alliance HIVE cells occupy y 0.39-0.90; field inner wall |x| = 1.8009, y in [-1.4773, 2.1245]
frame.far_side: unfav (far / unfavourable): x < 0 for pose_pos; gate centre is d + 0.401 m away horizontally
frame.near_side: fav (near / favourable): x > 0 for pose_pos, mouth faces the shooter; gate centre d - 0.401 m away horizontally
frame.pose: pose_pos (red up cell on +x). For pose_neg mirror x -> -x.
frame.hives: both HIVEs hang from one A-frame at the field centre, centre-to-centre 0.6477 m; A-frame base |x| < 0.4945, y in [-0.3044, 0.9516]
frame.psi: psi = atan(|y| / Lh), Lh = d + 0.401 (far) or max(d - 0.401, 1e-3) (near); symmetric in sign(y)

grid.psi_side_wall_how: PREDICTED straight-line estimate: atan((0.254 - 0.0355) / 0.30556) with cell half-width 0.254, ball radius 0.0355, cell depth 0.30556 (all CONFIRMED/derived, hive_geometry.json); ball enters on the centre line, no lateral roof profile; windows at or above it are optimistic
grid.order: mask file = u32 n | u32 off[nPsi*nH+1] | u32 idx[n] | u16 margin[n] | u16 ang[n]; slice (ip*nH+ih) = entries off[s]..off[s+1]; idx = id*nV*nTh + iv*nTh + ith (sorted)
grid.coarsened: v/theta steps: far 0.05/0.2 (page 2D grid 0.05/0.1); near 0.1/0.5; d step 0.05; psi step 5 deg

integrator.frame: planar flight in the vertical plane of the bearing; X, VX scaled by cos(psi)
